summary_notes: SYM (Symbotic Inc.) shares dropped ~8% Thursday following insider stock sales by company executives. Also fell ~8.41% on concerns about competitive position vs Serve Robotics despite positive revenue growth, while broader market rose. Q2 2026 earnings published May 6, 2026: Q2 revenue $676.48M beat consensus $662.65M; GAAP profitability achieved; backlog $22.7B; Q3 guidance projects further growth.
